Regulation FD Disclosure. The Company issued a press release on August 25, 2026, announcing it has refranchised the restaurants previously owned and operated by Papa John's USA, Inc. A copy of the press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1 hereto. The information in the press release is being furnished, not filed, pursuant to Item 7.01 of Form 8-K. Accordingly, the information in Item 7.01 of this Current Report, including Exhibit 99.1, will not be incorporated by reference into any registration statement filed by the Company under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, or into any filing of the Company under the Securities Exchange of 1934, as amended, unless specifically identified therein as being incorporated by reference.
